name: Kalimat Search API
description: Enterprise AI-powered semantic search engine spanning the Holy Quran (114 chapters), Sahih Sittah canonical Hadith collections, and authentic Athkar/supplications across 130+ translations. Understands conceptual and natural language questions, cross-lingual querying, and offers granular filtering by Hadith grading and source books.

authentication.description: Requires an API key passed in the X-Api-Key HTTP header. Keys can be requested via info@kalimat.dev.

rateLimit.policy: Tiered by enterprise subscription with dedicated latency guarantees.

supportedContentRepositories.description: All 114 Surahs and 6,236 Ayahs with translation embeddings
Kutub al-Sittah (Bukhari, Muslim, Abu Dawood, Tirmidhi, Nasa'i, Ibn Majah)
Authentic daily supplications and remembrances from Hisn al-Muslim and Sunnah

endpoints.name: Semantic AI Search
endpoints.description: Executes semantic, natural language, or reference search queries across Quran, Hadith, or Azkar.

parameters.name: getText
parameters.description: Include full Arabic text and translations in response

parameters.name: getMetadata
parameters.description: Include Hadith metadata (matn, isnad, grade, chapter)

parameters.name: userLang
parameters.description: Language code for translations (e.g. en, fr, ur)

parameters.name: hadithSourceBook
parameters.description: Comma-separated Hadith collections (bukhari, muslim, abudaud, tirmizi, nesai, ibnmaja)

parameters.name: hadithGrade
parameters.description: Filter by grading (sahih, hasan, daif, munkar, maudu, other)

parameters.name: hadithChapter
parameters.description: Filter by chapter number when a single hadithSourceBook is specified

results.translation: And We will surely test you with something of fear and hunger and a loss of wealth and lives and fruits, but give good tidings to the patient.

endpoints.name: Quick Search / Autocomplete
endpoints.description: Fast autocomplete endpoint optimized for search input boxes, suggesting navigational references or direct Surah/Hadith matches.

endpoints.name: Search Engine Version
endpoints.description: Returns current model version and semantic index build details.
